evidence: arXiv:2201.10874 abstract: SpecFuzzer 'combines grammar-based fuzzing, dynamic invariant detection, and mutation analysis, to automatically produce class specifications'; Daikon discards invalidated candidates; mutation analysis clusters and ranks. Authors Molina, d'Amorim, Aguirre.
correction: Venue: ICSE 2022 (arXiv preprint 2201.10874). Ranking is by mutation analysis (killed mutants), after clustering.

evidence: Abstract: 'generates around five times as many relevant assertion clauses as written by programmers; but it only finds around 60% of those originally written... Around a third of the generated...' clauses incorrect or irrelevant.
correction: Authors Polikarpova, Ciupa, Meyer; ISSTA 2009, pp. 93-104. 25 classes, >19,500 inferred clauses.

evidence: Abstract (ORBilu postprint PDF): 'on average, they misclassify 9.1% to 31.7% of correct invariants and 26.1%-58.6% of incorrect invariants.'
correction: Staats, Hong, Kim, Rothermel, ISSTA 2012. Use exact wording above; note the intro text says 9.1-39.8% for correct invariants (internal inconsistency), so cite the abstract figures.

evidence: Abstract: 'ClearView (1) observes normal executions to learn invariants...'; Red Team 'ten code-injection' exploits; 'For seven of the ten exploits, ClearView automatically generated patches' that corrected the error.
correction: Perkins et al., SOSP 2009, pp. 87-102. Works on stripped x86 binaries; blocked all ten exploits, corrective patches for seven.

evidence: Abstract (ICSE 2022): factors (training data selection, grouping, class distribution, noise, early detection) 'all have significant impact on the evaluation'; 'The problem of log-based anomaly detection has not been solved yet.'
correction: Le & Zhang, ICSE 2022; five DL models, four public datasets.

evidence: Sec 3.3 lists six heuristic rules ('a selection of the heuristic rules'); 'rely on the end user to select from and validate our suggestions which might not necessarily hold for future data'. Sec 5.3/Table 3: 10% sample, 90% coverage; lang range and statuses_count isUnique fail.
correction: Schelter et al., PVLDB 11(12) 2018. Paper says the six are 'a selection' of rules, not exhaustive. Categorical constraint is isInRange on lang; the false isUnique was corrected by the column-name classifier (2% probability).
